map.由力的大小、位移与夹角，按 W = F·d·cosθ 计算恒力所做的功。: Compute the work done by a constant force from its magnitude, displacement and included angle with W = F·d·cosθ.
map.θ=90° 时力不做功；力与位移反向（θ=180°）时做功为负。: At θ=90° the force does no work; when the force opposes displacement (θ=180°) the work is negative.
map.起重、搬运等场景中估算力所做的功。: Estimate the work done by a force in lifting, moving and similar scenarios.
map.垂直力不做功？: Does a perpendicular force do no work?
map.力垂直位移(θ=90°)时 cosθ=0，不做功。: When the force is perpendicular to displacement (θ=90°), cosθ=0, so no work is done.
map.多个力做功怎么算？: How to compute work from multiple forces?
map.合外力做功等于各分力做功的代数和（含负功）。: The net work equals the algebraic sum of the work done by each force (including negative work).
map.恒力做功（本页代码口径，θ 先化弧度）：W=F·d·cosθ（J，1 位）；沿位: Work by a constant force (per this page's code, θ converted to radians first): W=F·d·cosθ (J, 1 decimal); component along displacement=F·cosθ (N, 3 decimals); perpendicular component=F·sinθ (N, 3 decimals). Validation: no input guards; non-numeric values fall back to 0. Grading: θ<90° gives W>0 positive work, θ=90° gives W=0 no work, θ>90° gives W<0 negative work; the sweep chart shows the cosine falloff of work and the sine arch of the perpendicular component from 0° to 180° every 15°.
